scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,server,web -c yellow,blue,magenta "npm run watch -w packages/shared" "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run dev -w apps/server
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run dev -w apps/web
